description: Read the grants naming your wallet. On mainnet they allow only preparing orders, drafting listings and reading saved addresses; the person approves and pays or publishes. Only the person can create or revoke a grant at /delegation. Ask them for its id and send it as delegationGrantId. Bind the challenge to GET /api/agent/delegation/grants with no body.

delegationGrantId.description: A live grant id from get_delegation. Put the same value in auth_challenge targetArguments so the selector is in the signed message; it becomes X-Delegation-Grant and is never part of the target JSON body.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.

name: get_delegation
title: What you are allowed to do for somebody
